in_marathi.name: Iyappan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iyappan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayyappan is a name of Lord Ayyappan, a deity worshipped in Kerala and Tamil Nadu. He is believed to protect devotees from all dangers and fulfill their desires. His name is derived from the words ayyam (eternal) and pada (foot), indicating that he is the lord who is always present and protects with his feet.
